items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Are you living in Charlie Elgar's bands? ... Oh, yeah. ... How many pieces in Charlie Elgar's band? ... Well, we had at that time... 22.

ctx.x: Yeah. And was Oliver also playing there? No, he went to the Pekin. And where did you go? At Dreamland. Oh, you went to the Dreamland where Oliver had left. That's how much nerve I had. I didn't... You were following Oliver on the bandstand, you know.

Let's do that now. That's true. I should have had some nerve. I think about that quite a bit. You didn't get to play much jazz with Charlie Elgar, did you? That's all he was playing other than waltzes, playing dance music. Uh-huh. Oh, yeah.
What kind of a place was the Dreamland Ballroom?
